--ac-bias.description: Sets the strength of the internal RD metric to bias toward high-frequency error (helps with texture preservation and film grain retention)
--ac-bias.label: AC Bias

--adaptive-film-grain.description: Allows film grain synthesis to be sourced from different block sizes depending on resolution
--adaptive-film-grain.label: Adaptive Film Grain

--alt-ssim-tuning.description: Enables the usage of VQ optimizations and an alternative SSIM calculation pathway (Only operates with tunes 2 & 4)
--alt-ssim-tuning.label: Alt SSIM Tuning

--alt-tf-decay.description: Apply Tune 0/3 alt-ref TF decay tweak to any tune
--alt-tf-decay.label: Alt TF Decay

--asm.description: Limit assembly instruction set [c, mmx, sse, sse2, sse3, ssse3, sse4_1, sse4_2, avx, avx2, avx512, avx512icl, max] for x86 platforms, [c, neon, crc32, neon_dotprod, neon_i8mm, sve, sve2] for Arm platforms.
--asm.label: Asm

--auto-tiling.description: Automatically sets tiles appropriate for the source input resolution
--auto-tiling.label: Auto Tiling

--balancing-luminance-beta-bias.description: Boost rate control via beta in dark super blocks
--balancing-luminance-beta-bias.label: Balancing Luminance Beta Bias

--balancing-luminance-lambda-bias.description: Enable balancing luminance lambda bias. Bias lambda in mode decision in super block with low luminance.
--balancing-luminance-lambda-bias.label: Balancing Luminance Lambda Bias

--balancing-mg-dist-r0-bias.description: Boost rate control via r0 in frames with high mini-gop dist
--balancing-mg-dist-r0-bias.label: Balancing Mg Dist R0 Bias

--balancing-noise-level-r0-bias.description: Boost rate control via r0 in frames with high --balancing noise level
--balancing-noise-level-r0-bias.label: Balancing Noise Level R0 Bias

--balancing-q-bias.description: Enable balancing Q bias. It biases TPL at frame and superblock level for better detail retention.
--balancing-q-bias.label: Balancing Q Bias

--balancing-r0-dampening-layer.description: Dampen r0-based boosting in frames with temporal layer higher than or equal to hierarchical levels + --balancing-r0-dampening-layer. This affects a wide range of features and can be used without --balancing-q-bias.
--balancing-r0-dampening-layer.label: Balancing R0 Dampening Layer

--balancing-texture-lambda-bias.description: Enable balancing texture lambda bias. Bias lambda in low variance regions.
--balancing-texture-lambda-bias.label: Balancing Texture Lambda Bias

--balancing-tpl-intra-mode-beta-bias.description: Boost rate control via beta in super blocks where TPL search favours intra instead of inter prediction modes
--balancing-tpl-intra-mode-beta-bias.label: Balancing TPL Intra Mode Beta Bias

--balancing-variance-beta-bias.description: Boost rate control via beta in super blocks with low variance
--balancing-variance-beta-bias.label: Balancing Variance Beta Bias

--buf-initial-sz.description: Client initial buffer size (ms), only applicable for CBR
--buf-initial-sz.label: Buf Initial Sz

--buf-optimal-sz.description: Client optimal buffer size (ms), only applicable for CBR
--buf-optimal-sz.label: Buf Optimal Sz

--buf-sz.description: Client maximum buffer size (ms), only applicable for CBR
--buf-sz.label: Buf Sz

--cdef-bias.description: Enable CDEF bias, which comes with a fix on CDEF signalling bits, SAD & MSE based distortion calculation, CDEF strength taper, and various other improvements.
--cdef-bias.label: CDEF Bias

--cdef-bias-damping-offset.description: Use bigger or smaller CDEF damping. CDEF damping is a CDEF feature (not a --cdef-bias feature), normally derived from each frame's base_q_idx.
--cdef-bias-damping-offset.label: CDEF Bias Damping Offset

--cdef-bias-max-cdef.description: Max CDEF strength in the order of primary strength for Y, secondary strength for Y, primary strength for chroma, secondary strength for chroma. Primary strengths can be any value betwen 0 and 15, and secondary strengths can be either 0, 1, 2, or 4.
--cdef-bias-max-cdef.label: CDEF Bias Max CDEF

--cdef-bias-max-sec-cdef-rel.description: Secondary CDEF strength of every filtering block should be smaller than or equal to primary CDEF strength plus this value.
--cdef-bias-max-sec-cdef-rel.label: CDEF Bias Max Sec CDEF Rel

--cdef-bias-min-cdef.description: Min CDEF strength in the order of primary strength for Y, secondary strength for Y, primary strength for chroma, secondary strength for chroma. Primary strengths can be any value betwen 0 and 15, and secondary strengths can be either 0, 1, 2, or 4. CDEF strength of 0 will always be evaluated.
--cdef-bias-min-cdef.label: CDEF Bias Min CDEF

--chroma-grain.description: Control whether chroma grain is applied when using film grain
--chroma-grain.label: Chroma Grain

--chroma-qindex-offsets.description: list of chroma Q index offsets per hierarchical layer, separated by , with each offset in the range of
--chroma-qindex-offsets.label: Chroma Qindex Offsets

--chroma-sample-position.description: Chroma sample position signalled for 4:2:0; the encoder also accepts left and topleft.
--chroma-sample-position.label: Chroma Sample Position

--chroma-u-ac-qindex-offset.description: Overwrite the encoder default ac Q index offset for chroma Cb plane
--chroma-u-ac-qindex-offset.label: Chroma U AC Qindex Offset

--chroma-u-dc-qindex-offset.description: Overwrite the encoder default dc Q index offset for chroma Cb plane
--chroma-u-dc-qindex-offset.label: Chroma U DC Qindex Offset

--chroma-v-ac-qindex-offset.description: Overwrite the encoder default ac Q index offset for chroma Cr plane
--chroma-v-ac-qindex-offset.label: Chroma V AC Qindex Offset

--chroma-v-dc-qindex-offset.description: Overwrite the encoder default dc Q index offset for chroma Cr plane
--chroma-v-dc-qindex-offset.label: Chroma V DC Qindex Offset

--color-primaries.description: Colour primaries written into the AV1 sequence header.
--color-primaries.label: Color Primaries

--color-range.description: Luma/chroma range signalled in the bitstream.
--color-range.label: Color Range

--content-light.description: Content light level: max_cll,max_fall in nits.
--content-light.label: Content Light

--crf.description: Constant Rate Factor value, setting this value is equal to --rc 0 --aq-mode 2 --qp x, and can be set up in quarter-step increments
--crf.label: CRF

--dlf-bias.description: Enable DLF bias, which comes with a new DLF search algorithm, DLF --ac-bias, and a limit on maxmimum and minimum DLF strength.
--dlf-bias.label: DLF Bias

--dlf-bias-max-dlf.description: Max DLF strength for luma and chroma. DLF strength can be between 0 and 63.
--dlf-bias-max-dlf.label: DLF Bias Max DLF

--dlf-bias-min-dlf.description: Min DLF strength for luma and chroma. DLF strength can be between 0 and 63. DLF strength 0 will not be considered if this is set higher than 0.
--dlf-bias-min-dlf.label: DLF Bias Min DLF

--dlf-sharpness.description: Use a different sharpness for DLF. This can be used without --dlf-bias.
--dlf-sharpness.label: DLF Sharpness

--enable-dg.description: Enable Dynamic GoP. The algorithm changes the hierarchical structure based on the content
--enable-dg.label: Enable Dg

--enable-hdr.description: Enable writing of HDR metadata in the bitstream
--enable-hdr.label: Enable HDR

--enable-tpl-la.description: Temporal Dependency model control, currently forced on library side, only applicable for CRF/CQP
--enable-tpl-la.label: Enable TPL La

--fast-decode.description: Tune settings to output bitstreams that can be decoded faster, [0 = OFF, 1,2 = levels for decode-targeted optimization (2 yields faster decoder speed)]. Defaults to 5 temporal layers structure but may override with --hierarchical-levels
--fast-decode.label: Fast Decode

--fgs-table.description: Film-grain model table to apply during encoding.
--fgs-table.label: FGS Table

--film-grain-denoise.description: Apply denoising when film grain is ON
--film-grain-denoise.label: Film Grain Denoise

--filtering-noise-detection.description: Controls noise detection which disables CDEF/restoration when noise level is high enough, enabled by default on tunes 0 and 3
--filtering-noise-detection.label: Filtering Noise Detection

--force-key-frames.description: Force key frames at the comma separated specifiers. #f for frames, #.#s for seconds
--force-key-frames.label: Force Key Frames

--fps.description: Input video frame rate, integer values only, inferred if y4m
--fps.label: Fps

--frame-luma-bias.description: Adjusts frame-level QP based on average luminance across each frame
--frame-luma-bias.label: Frame Luma Bias

--gop-constraint-rc.description: Constrains the rate control to match the target rate for each GoP
--gop-constraint-rc.label: GOP Constraint RC

--hbd-mds.description: Activation of high bit depth mode decision (0: default behavior, 1: full 10b MD, 2: hybrid 8/10b MD, 3: full 8b MD)
--hbd-mds.label: HBD MDS

--hierarchical-levels.description: Set hierarchical levels beyond the base layer
--hierarchical-levels.label: Hierarchical Levels

--key-frame-chroma-qindex-offset.description: Overwrite the encoder default chroma keyframe Q index assignment
--key-frame-chroma-qindex-offset.label: Key Frame Chroma Qindex Offset

--key-frame-qindex-offset.description: Overwrite the encoder default keyframe Q index assignment
--key-frame-qindex-offset.label: Key Frame Qindex Offset

--keyint.description: GOP size (frames) [-2: 257 frames, or 321 frames when --balancing-q-bias 1 is used, -1: "infinite" only for CRF and setting --scd 0, 0: "infinite" only for CRF]
--keyint.label: Keyint

--kf-tf-strength.description: Manually adjust temporal filtering strength for keyframes. Higher values = stronger temporal filtering
--kf-tf-strength.label: KF TF Strength

--lambda-scale-factors.description: list of scale factors for lambda values used for different SvtAv1FrameUpdateType, separated by , divide by 128 is the actual scale factor in float
--lambda-scale-factors.label: Lambda Scale Factors

--level.description: Bitstream level, defined in A.3 of the av1 spec
--level.label: Level

--lineart-energy-bias.description: Prefer higher energy even if the encode will have higher energy than the source in high variance regions.
--lineart-energy-bias.label: Lineart Energy Bias

--lineart-psy-bias.description: Improve line-art retention. 3 is a general starting point; 4-5 focus on weak line art; 6-7 add variance and block-size taper. -2 enables variance-threshold testing.
--lineart-psy-bias.label: Lineart PSY Bias

--lineart-variance-thr.description: Variance threshold above which detail is treated as line art by --lineart-psy-bias.
--lineart-variance-thr.label: Lineart Variance Thr

--lookahead.description: Number of frames in the future to look ahead, beyond minigop, temporal filtering, and rate control
--lookahead.label: Lookahead

--low-q-taper.description: Avoid boosting macroblocks to extremely low q levels.
--low-q-taper.label: Low Q Taper

--luma-y-dc-qindex-offset.description: Overwrite the encoder default dc Q index offset for luma plane
--luma-y-dc-qindex-offset.label: Luma Y DC Qindex Offset

--matrix-coefficients.description: Matrix coefficients written into the AV1 sequence header.
--matrix-coefficients.label: Matrix Coefficients

--max-32-tx-size.description: Restricts use of block transform sizes to a maximum of 32x32 pixels (disabled: use max of 64x64 pixels)
--max-32-tx-size.label: Max 32 TX Size

--max-qp.description: Maximum (highest) quantizer, only applicable for VBR and CBR
--max-qp.label: Max QP

--maxsection-pct.description: GOP max bitrate (expressed as a percentage of the target rate)
--maxsection-pct.label: Maxsection Pct

--mbr.description: Maximum Bitrate (kbps) only applicable for CRF encoding, also accepts b, k, and m suffixes
--mbr.label: Mbr

--mbr-overshoot-pct.description: Allowable datarate overshoot (max) target (%), Only applicable for Capped CRF
--mbr-overshoot-pct.label: Mbr Overshoot Pct

--min-qp.description: Minimum (lowest) quantizer with the max value being max QP value allowed - 1, only applicable for VBR and CBR
--min-qp.label: Min QP

--minsection-pct.description: GOP min bitrate (expressed as a percentage of the target rate)
--minsection-pct.label: Minsection Pct

--nch.description: Number of channels (library instance) that will be instantiated
--nch.label: Nch

--noise-level-thr.description: Change encoder noise level threshold. Further explanations can be found below.
--noise-level-thr.label: Noise Level Thr

--noise-norm-strength.description: Selectively boost AC coefficients to improve fine detail retention in certain circumstances
--noise-norm-strength.label: Noise Norm Strength

--noise-psy-bias.description: Improve noise retention. Higher levels reduce noise normalisation and preserve grain-like detail.
--noise-psy-bias.label: Noise PSY Bias

--overshoot-pct.description: Allowable datarate overshoot (max) target (%), default depends on the rate control mode
--overshoot-pct.label: Overshoot Pct

--photon-noise.description: Generate photon noise table for film grain
--photon-noise.label: Photon Noise

--pin.description: Pin the execution to the first N cores. [0: no pinning, N: number of cores to pin to]. Refer to Appendix A.1
--pin.label: Pin

--preset.description: Encoder preset, presets -3, -2, & 13 are for debugging. Higher presets means faster encodes, but with a quality tradeoff
--preset.label: Preset

--psy-bias-inter-mode-bias.description: Bias against intra mode in non base layers
--psy-bias-inter-mode-bias.label: PSY Bias Inter Mode Bias

--psy-bias-mds0-intra-inter-mode-bias.description: Bias towards intra mode in base layers, and against intra mode in non base layers
--psy-bias-mds0-intra-inter-mode-bias.label: PSY Bias Mds0 Intra Inter Mode Bias

--psy-bias-optimize-b.description: Optimize quantization using full distortion calculation. Slow.
--psy-bias-optimize-b.label: PSY Bias Optimize B

--psy-bias-qm-bias.description: Increase QM level in frames of higher temporal layer
--psy-bias-qm-bias.label: PSY Bias QM Bias

--qindex-offsets.description: list of luma Q index offsets per hierarchical layer, separated by , with each offset in the range of
--qindex-offsets.label: Qindex Offsets

--qp-scale-compress-strength.description: Sets the strength the QP scale algorithm compresses values across all temporal layers, which results in more consistent video quality (less quality variation across frames in a mini-gop)
--qp-scale-compress-strength.label: QP Scale Compress Strength

--qpfile.description: Path to a file containing per picture QP value
--qpfile.label: Qpfile

--rc.description: Rate control mode [0: CRF or CQP (if --aq-mode is 0) [Default], 1: VBR, 2: CBR]
--rc.label: RC

--recode-loop.description: Recode loop level, look at the "Recode loop level table" in the user's guide for more info
--recode-loop.label: Recode Loop

--satd-bias.description: Add SATD calculation to distortion calculation.
--satd-bias.label: SATD Bias

--scd.description: Scene change detection control [--balancing-q-bias flavoured scd when --balancing-q-bias 1 is used]
--scd.label: Scd

options.label: Minigop size adjusted to the requested position
Minigop inserted at the requested position in decode order

--sharp-tx.description: Activation of sharp transform optimizations for higher fidelity encoding (cleaner output with slightly higher chances of artifacting)
--sharp-tx.label: Sharp TX

--sharpness.description: Bias towards block sharpness in rate-distortion optimization of transform coefficients
--sharpness.label: Sharpness

--startup-mg-size.description: Specify another mini-gop configuration for the first mini-gop after the key-frame
--startup-mg-size.label: Startup Mg Size

--static-fgs-seed.description: Use a static seed for FGS. This applies to --film-grain, --photon-noise, and --fgs-table. In the case of --photon-noise and --fgs-table, this will create a static noise.
--static-fgs-seed.label: Static FGS Seed

--tbr.description: Target Bitrate (kbps), only applicable for VBR and CBR encoding, also accepts b, k, and m suffixes
--tbr.label: Tbr

--texture-ac-bias.description: --ac-bias strength in low variance regions. Application based on --texture-variance-thr, and protection based on --lineart-variance-thr.
--texture-ac-bias.label: Texture AC Bias

--texture-cdef-bias-max-cdef.description: Max CDEF strength in low variance region. Using --lineart-variance-thr.
--texture-cdef-bias-max-cdef.label: Texture CDEF Bias Max CDEF

--texture-cdef-bias-max-sec-cdef-rel.description: Secondary CDEF strength of every filtering block should be smaller than or equal to primary CDEF strength plus this value in low variance region. Using --lineart-variance-thr.
--texture-cdef-bias-max-sec-cdef-rel.label: Texture CDEF Bias Max Sec CDEF Rel

--texture-cdef-bias-min-cdef.description: Min CDEF strength in low variance region. CDEF strength of 0 will always be evaluated. Using --lineart-variance-thr.
--texture-cdef-bias-min-cdef.label: Texture CDEF Bias Min CDEF

--texture-energy-bias.description: Prefer higher energy even if the encode will have higher energy than the source in low variance regions. Application based on --texture-variance-thr, and protection based on --lineart-variance-thr.
--texture-energy-bias.label: Texture Energy Bias

--texture-psy-bias.description: Improve texture retention. Higher levels progressively enable texture AC bias, energy bias, and variance-based decisions.
--texture-psy-bias.label: Texture PSY Bias

--texture-psy-bias-optimize-b.description: Optimize quantization using full distortion calculation in low variance region. Using --texture-variance-thr
--texture-psy-bias-optimize-b.label: Texture PSY Bias Optimize B

--texture-variance-thr.description: Variance threshold below which detail is treated as texture by --texture-psy-bias.
--texture-variance-thr.label: Texture Variance Thr

--tf-strength.description: Manually adjust temporal filtering strength. Higher values = stronger temporal filtering
--tf-strength.label: TF Strength

--tile-columns.description: Number of tile columns to use, TileCol == log2(x), default changes per resolution
--tile-columns.label: Tile Columns

--tile-rows.description: Number of tile rows to use, TileRow == log2(x), default changes per resolution
--tile-rows.label: Tile Rows

--transfer-characteristics.description: Transfer characteristics written into the AV1 sequence header.
--transfer-characteristics.label: Transfer Characteristics

--tune.description: Optimize the encoding process for different desired outcomes
--tune.label: Tune

--undershoot-pct.description: Allowable datarate undershoot (min) target (%), default depends on the rate control mode (25 for CBR, 50 for VBR)
--undershoot-pct.label: Undershoot Pct

--use-fixed-qindex-offsets.description: Overwrite the encoder default hierarchical layer based QP assignment and use fixed Q index offsets
--use-fixed-qindex-offsets.label: Use Fixed Qindex Offsets

--use-q-file.description: Overwrite the encoder default picture based QP assignments and use QP values from --qp-file
--use-q-file.label: Use Q File

--variance-boost-strength.description: Set variance curve strength for variance boost feature [1: mild, 2: gentle [Default], 3: medium, 4: aggressive]
--variance-boost-strength.label: Variance Boost Strength

--variance-octile.description: Set variance algorithm 8x8 block selectivity level [1: 1st octile, 4: median, 5: 5th octile [Default], 8: maximum]
--variance-octile.label: Variance Octile

--ac-bias.description: Sets the strength of the internal RD metric to bias toward high-frequency error (helps with texture preservation and film grain retention)
--ac-bias.label: AC Bias

--adaptive-film-grain.description: Allows film grain synthesis to be sourced from different block sizes depending on resolution
--adaptive-film-grain.label: Adaptive Film Grain

--asm.label: Asm

--auto-tiling.label: Auto Tiling

--buf-initial-sz.label: Buf Initial Sz

--buf-optimal-sz.label: Buf Optimal Sz

--buf-sz.description: Client maximum buffer size (ms), only applicable for CBR
--buf-sz.label: Buf Sz

--chroma-sample-position.description: Chroma sample position signalled for 4:2:0; the encoder also accepts left and topleft.
--chroma-sample-position.label: Chroma Sample Position

--chroma-u-ac-qindex-offset.description: Overwrite the encoder default ac Q index offset for chroma Cb plane
--chroma-u-ac-qindex-offset.label: Chroma U AC Qindex Offset

--chroma-u-dc-qindex-offset.description: Overwrite the encoder default dc Q index offset for chroma Cb plane
--chroma-u-dc-qindex-offset.label: Chroma U DC Qindex Offset

--chroma-v-ac-qindex-offset.description: Overwrite the encoder default ac Q index offset for chroma Cr plane
--chroma-v-ac-qindex-offset.label: Chroma V AC Qindex Offset

--chroma-v-dc-qindex-offset.description: Overwrite the encoder default dc Q index offset for chroma Cr plane
--chroma-v-dc-qindex-offset.label: Chroma V DC Qindex Offset

--color-primaries.description: Colour primaries written into the AV1 sequence header.
--color-primaries.label: Color Primaries

--color-range.description: Luma/chroma range signalled in the bitstream.
--color-range.label: Color Range

--complex-hvs.description: Activation of highest complexity HVS model (0: default behavior, 1: enable highest complexity HVS model)
--complex-hvs.label: Complex Hvs

--content-light.description: Content light level: max_cll,max_fall in nits.
--content-light.label: Content Light

--cqp.description: Constant Quality value, setting this value is similar to --rc 0 --aq-mode 0 --qp x. Compared to --qp, --cqp can take a value up to 70, and can be set in 0.25 increments
--cqp.label: CQP

--crf.description: Constant Rate Factor value, setting this value is similar to --rc 0 --aq-mode 2 --qp x. Compared to --qp, --crf can take a value up to 70, and can be set in 0.25 increments
--crf.label: CRF

--distortion-bias-preset.description: Preset that hard-sets parameters trading distortion for higher fidelity potential. Higher presets push more aggressively.
--distortion-bias-preset.label: Distortion Bias Preset

--dolby-vision-rpu.description: Dolby Vision RPU file to embed in the bitstream.
--dolby-vision-rpu.label: Dolby Vision RPU

--enable-alt-cdef.description: CDEF trade-off level. Higher levels favour fidelity over deringing and can cost speed.
--enable-alt-cdef.label: Enable Alt CDEF

--enable-alt-dlf.description: Deblocking trade-off level. Higher levels favour fidelity over deblocking and can cost speed.
--enable-alt-dlf.label: Enable Alt DLF

--enable-dg.description: Enable Dynamic GoP. The algorithm changes the hierarchical structure based on the content
--enable-dg.label: Enable Dg

--fast-decode.description: Tune settings to output bitstreams that can be decoded faster, [0 = OFF, 1,2 = levels for decode-targeted optimization (2 yields faster decoder speed), 3 = experimental, needs the ENABLE_FAST_DECODE_3 build option: 2 plus, for still images (--avif 1), CDEF and loop restoration off, quantization matrices on (luma 5, chroma 4), key-frame lambda scale 192, filter intra off and decoder-complexity RD terms; options set on the command line or through svt_av1_enc_parse_parameter() win (API callers assigning default values directly mark them in fast_decode_user_opts), other encodes behave as 2]. --fgs-seed.description: Film grain seed (1-65535) or comma-separated list; -1 uses a sequence optimized to reduce repeating grain patterns. Lists repeat one seed per frame; default changes the seed for each frame
--fgs-seed.label: FGS Seed

--fgs-table.description: Film-grain model table to apply during encoding.

--film-grain-denoise.description: Apply denoising when film grain is ON
--film-grain-denoise.label: Film Grain Denoise

--gop-constraint-rc.description: Constrains the rate control to match the target rate for each GoP

--intra-period.description: Distance between intra frames; -1 derives it from the keyframe interval.

--key-frame-chroma-qindex-offset.label: Key Frame Chroma Qindex Offset

--key-frame-qindex-offset.description: Overwrite the encoder default keyframe Q index assignment
--key-frame-qindex-offset.label: Key Frame Qindex Offset

--keyint.description: Max GOP size (frames), use s suffix for seconds (SvtAv1EncApp only)
--keyint.label: Keyint

--lambda-scale-factors.description: list of scale factors for lambda values used for different SvtAv1FrameUpdateType, separated by , divide by 128 is the actual scale factor in float
--lambda-scale-factors.label: Lambda Scale Factors

--level.description: Bitstream level, defined in A.3 of the av1 spec
--level.label: Level

--lookahead.description: Number of frames in the future to look ahead, beyond minigop, temporal filtering, and rate control
--lookahead.label: Lookahead

--lossless.description: Enable lossless coding; transform, quantisation and loop filters are bypassed.

--low-memory.description: Specifies whether to use params which reduce RAM consumption with potential efficiency and speed trade-offs

--luma-y-dc-qindex-offset.description: Overwrite the encoder default dc Q index offset for luma plane
--luma-y-dc-qindex-offset.label: Luma Y DC Qindex Offset

--luminance-qp-bias.description: Adjusts a frame's QP based on its average luma value

--matrix-coefficients.description: Matrix coefficients written into the AV1 sequence header.

--max-inter-bitrate-pct.description: Max bitrate for inter frames as a percentage of the target bitrate, 0 to disable
--max-inter-bitrate-pct.label: Max Inter Bitrate Pct

--max-intra-bitrate-pct.description: Max bitrate for intra frames as a percentage of the target bitrate, 0 to disable
--max-intra-bitrate-pct.label: Max Intra Bitrate Pct

--max-tx-size.description: Restricts use of block transform sizes to the specified value
--max-tx-size.label: Max TX Size

--maxsection-pct.description: GOP max bitrate (expressed as a percentage of the target rate)
--maxsection-pct.label: Maxsection Pct

--mbr.description: Maximum Bitrate (kbps) only applicable for CRF encoding, also accepts b, k, and m suffixes
--mbr.label: Mbr

--mbr-overshoot-pct.description: Allowable datarate overshoot (max) target (%), Only applicable for Capped CRF
--mbr-overshoot-pct.label: Mbr Overshoot Pct

--min-keyint.description: Min GOP size (frames), use s suffix for seconds (SvtAv1EncApp only)
--min-keyint.label: Min Keyint

--minsection-pct.description: GOP min bitrate (expressed as a percentage of the target rate)
--minsection-pct.label: Minsection Pct

--noise-adaptive-filtering.description: Controls noise detection which disables CDEF/restoration when noise level is high enough
--noise-adaptive-filtering.label: Noise Adaptive Filtering

--noise-norm-strength.description: Selectively boost AC coefficients to improve fine detail retention in certain circumstances
--noise-norm-strength.label: Noise Norm Strength

--overshoot-pct.description: Allowable datarate overshoot (max) target (%), default depends on the rate control mode
--overshoot-pct.label: Overshoot Pct

--photon-noise.description: Generate photon noise table for film grain
--photon-noise.label: Photon Noise

--pin.description: Pin the execution to the first N cores. [0: no pinning, N: number of cores to pin to]. Refer to Appendix A.1
--pin.label: Pin

--preset.description: Encoder preset. Higher presets means faster encodes, but with a quality tradeoff
--preset.label: Preset

--qindex-offsets.description: list of luma Q index offsets per hierarchical layer, separated by , with each offset in the range of
--qindex-offsets.label: Qindex Offsets

--qp-scale-compress-strength.description: Sets the strength the QP scale algorithm compresses values across all temporal layers, which results in more consistent video quality (less quality variation across frames in a mini-gop)
--qp-scale-compress-strength.label: QP Scale Compress Strength

--qpfile.description: Path to a file containing per picture QP value
--qpfile.label: Qpfile

--quality.description: Quality preset that overrides CRF and CQP; medium is the documented default.
--quality.label: Quality

--rc.description: Rate control mode [0: CRF or CQP (if --aq-mode is 0) [Default], 1: VBR, 2: CBR]
--rc.label: RC

--recode-loop.description: Recode loop level, look at the "Recode loop level table" in the user's guide for more info
--recode-loop.label: Recode Loop

--roi-map-file.description: Enable Region Of Interest and specify a picture based QP Offset map file
--roi-map-file.label: ROI Map File

options.label: Minigop size adjusted to the requested position
Minigop inserted at the requested position in decode order

--sframe-posi.description: S-Frame insertion positions, a list separated by ',', S-Frame process inserts by the specified frame numbers (0 based), only applicable for mode 3 and mode 4
--sframe-posi.label: SFRAME Posi

--sframe-qp.description: S-Frame setup QP, a list separated by ',', QP value(s) set with S-Frame insertion, with each QP in the range of [1-63]. If only one QP value is set, this QP is applied to all S-Frames
--sframe-qp.label: SFRAME QP

--sframe-qp-offset.description: S-Frame setup QP offset, a list separated by ',', QP offset value(s) set with S-Frame insertion, with each QP offset value in the range of [-63-63]. If only one QP offset value is set, this QP offset is applied to all S-Frames
--sframe-qp-offset.label: SFRAME QP Offset

--sharp-tx.description: Activation of sharp transform optimizations for higher fidelity encoding (with slightly higher chances of artifacting)
--sharp-tx.label: Sharp TX

--speed.description: Encoder speed preset. It overrides the numeric preset; the default is slow at 1080p and below and medium above.
--speed.label: Speed

--startup-mg-size.description: Specify another mini-gop configuration for the first mini-gop after the key-frame
--startup-mg-size.label: Startup Mg Size

--startup-qp-offset.description: Start-up GOP QP offset; will be added to the sequence-QP before deriving the picture-QP
--startup-qp-offset.label: Startup QP Offset

--tbr.description: Target Bitrate (kbps), only applicable for VBR and CBR encoding, also accepts b, k, and m suffixes
--tbr.label: Tbr

--tf-strength.description: Manually adjust temporal filtering strength. Higher values = stronger temporal filtering
--tf-strength.label: TF Strength

--tile-columns.description: Number of tile columns to use, TileCol == log2(x), default changes per resolution
--tile-columns.label: Tile Columns

--tile-rows.description: Number of tile rows to use, TileRow == log2(x), default changes per resolution
--tile-rows.label: Tile Rows

--transfer-characteristics.description: Transfer characteristics written into the AV1 sequence header.
--transfer-characteristics.label: Transfer Characteristics

--tune.description: Optimize the encoding process for different desired outcomes
--tune.label: Tune

--undershoot-pct.description: Allowable datarate undershoot (min) target (%), default depends on the rate control mode (25 for CBR, 50 for VBR)
--undershoot-pct.label: Undershoot Pct

--use-fixed-qindex-offsets.description: Overwrite the encoder default hierarchical layer based QP assignment and use fixed Q index offsets
--use-fixed-qindex-offsets.label: Use Fixed Qindex Offsets

--use-q-file.description: Overwrite the encoder default picture based QP assignments and use QP values from --qp-file
--use-q-file.label: Use Q File

--variance-boost-strength.description: Set variance curve strength for variance boost feature [1: mild [Default], 2: gentle, 3: medium, 4: aggressive]
--variance-boost-strength.label: Variance Boost Strength

--variance-octile.description: Set variance algorithm 8x8 block selectivity level [1: 1st octile, 4: median [Default], 6: 6th octile, 8: maximum]
--variance-octile.label: Variance Octile

--zones.description: Zones adjust base CRF/CQP for given (inclusive) frame ranges. Format: start1,end1,quality1;start2,end2,quality2;...
--zones.label: Zones
